title: auditor-skill findings.json
description: What /auditor:diff-audit --ci and /auditor:quick-scan --ci write to audit_<n>/findings.json. The command writes it first right after it makes the run directory, with final false and verdict fail, so a run that ends early leaves a failing record, and again at its end with every finding of its report and final true. templates/ci/verdict.jq checks it against the run's result, and templates/ci/findings-to-sarif.jq turns it into SARIF 2.1.0. It stays in the run directory: in CI on a public repository nothing of it is printed or uploaded (OUTPUT-RULES.md Rule 11d).

mode.description: The mode preflight's first line names (OUTPUT-RULES.md Rule 11f).

final.description: false while the run goes on; true once the command reached its last step, stopped early included. A file that stays false means the run ended before its last step.

verdict.description: fail when a finding counts at the threshold (severity at least threshold, rule5b passed, undetermined or not-required), when an analyzer the run called for did not run, when the run stopped early, or while final is false; pass otherwise.

stopped.description: none, or the step the run stopped at once its run directory existed: arguments (a --fail-on value or range the command does not take), changed-set (git-ro.sh could not give the range's changed files or pin its ends), denied (a call the run cannot do without was denied), corpus-pass (a checklist section or known-vector file that audit_<n>/scope.md lists was left unread), line-budget (with --over-budget fail, a change larger than the changed-code budget of references/depth-scope.md §6).

report.description: The run's report: audit_<n>/PR-REPORT.md for diff-audit, audit_<n>/QUICK-SCAN.md for quick-scan.

commits.description: The full commit ids git-ro.sh rev-parse pinned: base and head for diff-audit, head for quick-scan.

analyzers.description: Each analyzer this run called for, once: not-run when any of its calls did not run, ran otherwise. audit-scan when the bundled tools are built (for diff-audit, when a .rs file changed); for diff-audit lock-delta and deps-artifacts when a Cargo.lock, package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, yarn.lock or bun.lock changed (deps-artifacts is the lock-budget call: it ran on an empty budget too, and did not run when deps.sh could not start or a selected artifact still failed after one retry), web3js-history when the command ran it; for quick-scan semgrep (or the static-analysis or grep-scanners fallback it took), cargo-audit for a Cargo.lock, npm-audit for a package.json beside a package-lock.json or npm-shrinkwrap.json.

findings.description: Every finding of the report, in its order.

reason.description: For not-run: why, as the tool's own refusal or blocker line, or the denial.

severity.description: OUTPUT-RULES.md Rule 1, 1 to 10: the severity the report gives it, and for an [UNCONFIRMED] or [PARTIAL] finding the one it had before the Rule 5b gate downgraded it.

file.description: The file the finding cites, relative to the working directory, with no .. part.

rule5b.description: The Rule 5b status (OUTPUT-RULES.md): passed (a [FAIL-N], N at least 6, whose gate blocks are filled), undetermined ([UNDETERMINED]), unconfirmed ([UNCONFIRMED]), partial ([PARTIAL]), not-required (a [FAIL-N] with N at most 5). unconfirmed and partial never count toward the verdict.

refs.description: The checklist item and known-vector ids the finding fails, such as AV-015 or KV-139.
